requirements.title: Carrier range
requirements.description: The transceiver shall transmit between 144.001 and 147.999 MHz.

requirements.title: Carrier stability
requirements.description: The transceiver shall hold the carrier within 2.5 ppm.

requirements.title: Retired bandwidth
requirements.description: The transceiver shall occupy at most 150 Hz.

requirements.title: Receiver sensitivity
requirements.description: The receiver shall detect -140 dBm in 500 Hz.

requirements.title: Receiver demonstration
requirements.description: The receiver shall copy a CW signal on air.
